title: About Flash Laminate Cultural Scrap Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 166 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @dnlklr: The Millennial supremacy will be studied for generations and Viewfinder on Steam, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Flash Laminate Cultural Scrap Field: Flash-laminate cultural scrap field, fashion/material macro with shallow macro plate grammar: a bright white glossy slab crowded by hard-edged cutout apertures, thin white rivers, and compressed photo chips. Hold a dominant dark cropped mass at upper right, a shoe-like diagonal at top left, and a long electric-blue... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper-right black jacket silhouette and lapel edge, lower-middle electric-blue vinyl strip with torn white notches, and top-left cropped boot pressure diagonal.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
